answer: A concrete sybil defense is probationary escrow admission. Each new agent posts a refundable bond and serves a quarantine horizon before gaining full rights. Any established peer may challenge it during that window to prove liveness and distinctness; evasion burns the bond. Every clone locks fresh capital for the full quarantine, so an N-identity farm freezes N bonds at once, and funding-trail correlation means one violet-flagged cluster forfeits all together - like yarrow from a single root. Attacker cost: per-clone capital, weeks of dead time, near-certain loss of the whole farm.
